verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows engine and scheduled Reports let users configure background automations (auto-tagging high-risk inquiries, running additional reports on conditions, recurring Watchlist/PEP checks) plus webhooks for async status updates — all running without manual intervention. However, this is rule-based workflow automation, not AI-agent-driven automation, and there's no evidence of natural-language/AI-native setup of these automations. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/LLM-driven automation configuration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that workflows run reliably autonomously at scale.
